newsitem.title: DENMARK: POLL-Danish June unemployment seen falling to 8pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Danish June unemployment seen falling to 8pct.

text.p: Danish unemployment is expected to fall to an average seasonally-adjusted 8.0 percent of the workforce in June from May's 8.1 percent, eight analysts polled by Reuters said in a survey issued on Tuesday.
"Despite an increase in people on leave schemes, we expect to see more employed in June," one analyst told Reuters.
The estimates ranged from a low 7.9 percent to a high 8.1 percent. In June 1996, the Danish unemployment rate stood at 8.7 percent of the workforce.
The Danish national statistics office publishes its June unemployment data on Thursday August 7 at 0730 GMT. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
